messages:
Maria Chen: @Jordan @Lee quick sync — Spruce beta cohort needs kickoff + feedback cadence. Thinking week of Apr 12 for onboarding session, then a 2-week feedback pulse. Can you confirm availability and owners?
Jordan Patel: I can take the CS kickoff slot Wed Apr 13 10:00 PT. Two customer seats need 1:1 followup after onboarding. Is that ok? :thumbsup:
Ashok Kapoor: FYI finance pinged about contract terms — renewal convo penciled for late May. Would like early signals on satisfaction so we can prioritize.
Lee Nguyen: DevRel can run a 30m technical walk-through + office hours the next day (Thu Apr 14 09:00 PT). I can prepare a short how-to repo and a 10-slide slide deck.
Maria Chen: Awesome. I'll draft invites. Proposed feedback loop: 5-question form at 1 week, then 4-week NPS + optional short interview. Link placeholder: https://forms.gle/spruce-beta (will update)
DevOnboardBot: Meeting created: "Spruce Beta Kickoff" — Wed Apr 13 10:00 PT — invites sent to: intake@spruce.ai (automated)
Jordan Patel: Can EngRuntime add a lightweight telemetry ping for model latency & error rate during the beta? Need baseline before we tweak quant/throughput.
Lee Nguyen: I'll ask runtime team. Telemetry snippet for instrumentation:
```
event('spruce.inference.latency', {p90: latency_ms, model: 'redwood/spruce-v1'});
event('spruce.inference.error', {type: err_type, count: 1});
```
Maria Chen: Drafting onboarding email to customers — any must-have bullets? Draft below for quick edits.
Maria Chen: ```
Subject: Welcome to Spruce beta — getting started
Hi Spruce team,
Thanks for joining our beta. Kickoff is Wed Apr 13 10:00 PT. We'll cover integration, expected metrics, and how to submit feedback. Please join office hours on Thu Apr 14 for technical Qs.
Key asks: enable telemetry, fill the 1-week feedback form, and flag any blockers in #spruce-support.
Thanks, Maria (CS)
```
Ashok Kapoor: Looks good. Suggest cc'ing renewal contact (cc: finance lead) and add success criteria in the email so customers know our goals.
Jordan Patel: Proposed success criteria: >50% active seats, median latency <200ms, 4/5 average on ease-of-integration after week 4. I'll add those to the kickoff slides.
Lee Nguyen: Quick note — avoid sharing public roadmap in kickoff; prefer a private changelog link to prevent bias in feedback.
Maria Chen: Agree. I'll track action items: 1) Send invites (Maria), 2) Telemetry ping (Lee -> EngRuntime), 3) Feedback form live (Maria), 4) Slides + success criteria (Jordan), 5) CC renewal contact (Ashok). Will post an update by EOD Fri. :spiral_calendar: 
Jordan Patel: Sounds good. I'll follow up with account notes and block 1:1s for customers that show low engagement.
Lee Nguyen: Will prep repo + office-hours link and share before the kickoff.
DevOnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: "Send Spruce feedback form" — Fri Apr 16 09:00 PT (automated)
Maria Chen: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth. Ping me if anything slips. :handshake:
